description: Source code for the CandidateAttachmentAPI class within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin, implementing API endpoints for managing candidate attachments including create, get, and update operations.

classes.name: CandidateAttachmentAPI
classes.description: API class handling CRUD operations for candidate attachment entities within the recruitment module, including methods for creating, retrieving, and updating candidate attachments, with validation and attachment content handling.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception as fetching all candidate attachments is not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception; no validation rules for fetching all attachments.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new candidate attachment, processes the input data, and saves it through the recruitment attachment service.

methods.name: setCandidateAttachment
methods.description: Associates a CandidateAttachment entity with a candidate ID and sets its base64 encoded attachment data.

methods.name: setBase64Attachment
methods.description: Extracts Base64 attachment data from request parameters and sets filename, type, size, and content in the CandidateAttachment entity.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a candidate attachment, including entity ID existence and base64 attachment format.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception; deletion not available.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception; no validation rules for delete operation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific candidate attachment by candidate ID, returning the partial attachment data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation rule for the getOne operation, requiring candidate ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing candidate attachment or deletes it based on the request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a candidate attachment, including conditions for replacing or deleting the current attachment.

methods.name: getRecruitmentAttachment
methods.description: Wraps a CandidateAttachment entity into a RecruitmentAttachment DTO for API response.
